proposed.statement: At introduction, Pro $100 had a 5x standard Codex usage allowance relative to Plus; a limited promotion offered up to 10x.

effectiveDateEvidence: April 9 2026 ChatGPT release note introduces the tier and distinguishes 5x standard from temporary 10x Codex usage.

evidence.excerpt: For a limited time, up to 10x more Codex usage than Plus (up from 5X standard usage allowance).
